sections.advice: Baden Baden → Mummelsee is 23 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Mummelsee → Ruhestein climbs about 915 m in 5 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Ruhestein → Kniebis drops about 915 m over 15 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Kniebis → Freudenstadt is 10 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

scenicChapters.title: Schwarzwaldhochstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 38 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Schwarzwaldhochstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 16.9%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Schwarzwaldhochstrasse
scenicChapters.narrative: 915 m come off over 24 km at around 6.3%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

black-forest-high-road.story: A 89 km one-way ride from near Baden-Baden, about 1 h 32 of riding. The stops in between: Mummelsee, Ruhestein and Kniebis. The highest point is about 900 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
